statement: Rendered from explicit per-origin E3.2 policy evidence and human decision artifacts. Rendering does not create or approve a decision.

policies.attribution: Preserve World Bank attribution and represent provider content without promoting it to objective truth.
policies.rate_policy: Use only the bounded E2 country, indicator and year route; identify TWIRX, cache responses, obey published limits and do not broadly crawl.
policies.retention_policy: Retain bounded observations and immutable proof artifacts required for replay, attribution and audit.
policies.reviewer_notes: The documented public API route is approved with explicit bounds. The robots resource returned 404 and is recorded as unavailable rather than treated as access authorization.

policies.attribution: Preserve RFC Editor attribution and source-native lexical values for every historical archive statement.
policies.rate_policy: Only exact Common Crawl index queries and byte ranges for the approved homepage route and two periods are permitted; no live content crawl.
policies.retention_policy: Retain exact bounded historical evidence, derived packets and proof artifacts; never present archive evidence as current publisher state.
policies.reviewer_notes: Historical public-interest archive profiling is approved. Robots disallows three RFC subtrees; none is the approved homepage route. No live RFC content retrieval is authorized.

policies.attribution: Preserve TWIRX project attribution and source-native wording when reusing published project metadata.
policies.rate_policy: Only exact publisher-authored public project routes are permitted; the Atlas scheduler remains disabled for the FUTO release.
policies.retention_policy: Retain bounded public evidence and immutable proof artifacts; exclude private repository content, personal data and unpublished reports.
policies.reviewer_notes: Founder-controlled public origin approved for bounded public-read access. Robots permits all routes and advertises the public sitemap; the decision does not enable scheduled retrieval.
